stem.text: An object of weight $12\,\text{N}$ rests on a platform on top of a container with two pistons, as shown. The container contains a fixed mass of gas, and the pistons are free to move.

stem.alt: Container with two pistons: an object on a platform above a vertical piston on the top of the container, and a horizontal plunger and piston on the left side; labelled object, platform, piston, plunger and container.

stem.text: The plunger is slowly pushed $4.0\,\text{cm}$ to the right. As a result, the object slowly moves upwards a distance $0.50\,\text{cm}$.
How much work is done on the object?
